propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria through multiple independent seams, allowing project disables to be ignored, project DET criteria to disappear, and separate reads to describe inconsistent repository policy states.
A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must compile effective built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, and metadata with deterministic digest before any gate selection or model call.

Code-review project LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of repository-relative globs with ['**'] as the canonical spelling for repository-wide unconditional selection, while plan-review criteria retain the existing empty-list-legal validation.
The applies_to: ['**'] rule must unconditionally select criteria even when changed_files is empty, preserving the prior applies_to: [] behavior.

Contract tests must prove the snapshot contains effective built-in disables/retunes, activated project DET entries, and that the applies_to: [] to ['**'] migration preserves behavior including the empty-changed-files edge case.
